portfolio_margin_activated.meaning: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account

vault_holds_hl_position.meaning: The Vault holds a hedge or spot position on HyperLiquid

auto_borrow_triggered.meaning: HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow triggered due to adverse price movement, making the L1 account show spot USDC +X and 0x811 borrow.value +X while real net assets are unchanged

settle_accepts_unbacked_yield.meaning: settle accepts proposed yield that is not backed by real surplus (phantom surplus passes Gate 3 distributable cap and settle accepts unbacked yield)

claims.scope: Monetrix Vault surplus accounting and yield settlement via settle/distributeYield

preconditions.text: Portfolio Margin is activated on the Vault's L1 account.; The Vault holds a hedge or spot position on HyperLiquid.; HyperLiquid PM auto-borrow triggers due to adverse price movement (e.g. BTC drops), so the Vault's L1 account shows spot USDC = +X and 0x811 borrow.value = +X while real net assets are unchanged.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: settle must only accept proposed yield that is backed by real surplus (Σ proposedYield ≤ Σ surplus), not phantom surplus.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The phantom surplus passes Gate 3 distributable cap (INV-7) and settle accepts unbacked yield (INV-9).
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The keeper proposes yield up to the phantom surplus reported by the Accountant; no Operator collusion is required.
Gate 4 annualized cap is assumed passable for the moderate proposed amounts described.
The phantom surplus arises because PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance discards the borrow leg, so _readL1Backing sums supply.value without subtracting borrow.value.

limitations: The impact is formalized as the forbidden acceptance of unbacked yield; the separate backing_overstated and principal_displaced impacts are not covered by this plan.
Gate 3 distributable cap and Gate 4 annualized cap numeric thresholds are not given, so their pass/fail is represented only through the grounded acceptance Boolean.
